display_name: DURA 源域缓存与现算完整训练一致性
description: 固定相同恢复网络、初始种子、数据和五轮训练，先现算源 DURA 上下文，再复用同一缓存，比较完整训练时间、逐参数权重、损失和源诊断。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, batch 32

data.version: source cache R07 with fixed augmented epochs 21/22/23
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 8192 fixed eligible L_s/U_s source fit IDs excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: full source input tensor exact equality only; no target or identity metric

permissions.claim_scope: Technical source training parity and timing only; no target predictions and no new recovery variant

checkpoint.initialization: Identical DURA v1.0 and same initialized multiscale correction, seed 2026110612, for both technical replicates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source provenance verified by frozen_dura
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5 for both; no checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: fresh/final.pt and cached/final.pt: private source training checkpoints
result.json: exact weight, loss and source group comparison plus timings

metric_names: source loss and source group equality
dimensions: fresh and cached full five-epoch source training

rows.method: Same DURA multiscale recovery trained twice with and without source context cache
rows.purpose: Determine actual full training speed and exact checkpoint parity
rows.seed_notes: Fixed model initialization 2026110612, source fit 2026110611, optimizer order 2026110613; DURA seed 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: Two fixed 5-epoch source training replicates, 8192 source IDs x 3 views, batch 32
expected_artifacts: fresh/final.pt and cached/final.pt: private source training checkpoints
result.json: exact weight, loss and source group comparison plus timings

notes: Technical repeat of the same fixed model, not a new architecture or target-score-driven selection.
No target IQ, F weights/outputs, TX labels or V used.
Two source training runs executed sequentially on the same selected GPU; full elapsed time includes each process source diagnostic.
Exact parameters are necessary evidence but do not alone prove identical ground predictions across devices or environments.
